quests.title: A Parcel for Dover
quests.summary: Carry a brown-paper parcel to a relative in Dover, then bring word back to Canterbury.

steps.line: Oh, from Canterbury? That'll be my sister's doing. A cardigan, again. Tell her I'm wearing the last one.

steps.text: Take the word back to Canterbury.
steps.line: Oh, you've been! And she's wearing it? Well. That's me told, and a tea owed to you.

start.ask: Oh, would you do me a kindness? There's a parcel here for my sister in Dover. It's only a cardigan and a lot of string.
start.accept: Marvellous. Mind the string, it's load-bearing.

quests.title: An Overdue Book
quests.summary: Return a library book that has wandered a long way, and tell the owner in Dover it has gone home.

steps.line: Eleven years! We'd given it up for the Great Fire. There's no fine, but there is a look.

steps.text: Tell Dover it has gone back.
steps.line: Gone back, and no fine? I'll leave the house with my head up. Here, for your trouble.

start.ask: Oh, this book is eleven years overdue and I've gone off the idea of walking it back. Could you take it to Oxford?
start.accept: Say it's from a friend. Say it was lost in a flood. Say anything.
